title: SHM: acceleration proportional to displacement, and opposite
caption: In SHM a = −ω²x: a straight line through the origin with gradient −ω². At 2.0 Hz, ω = 12.57 rad s⁻¹, so at the amplitude 0.05 m the acceleration is a_max = ω²A = 7.9 m s⁻² (and v_max = ωA = 0.63 m s⁻¹ at x = 0).
alt: Acceleration against displacement: a straight line with negative gradient through the origin, from plus 7.9 at minus 0.05 metres to minus 7.9 at plus 0.05.
description: The line a = −157.9x runs between x = ±0.05 m.
The minus sign means the acceleration always points back towards equilibrium.
